assessment: CPU source/provenance/alpha inventory only; no anatomy, pose, gameplay, lighting, or native rendering approval implied. Existing original and accepted runtime files are hashed as observed in the working tree at this fixed HEAD.

stage.name: U
stage.prompt: Remove the entire near-side arm, including the shoulder, sleeve, forearm, wrist and hand. Paint the complete unobstructed torso, waist, hip and near-side thigh that were hidden behind this arm. Keep the helmet, boots, far-side leg, body proportions, outline, pose, colors and all remaining pixels exactly unchanged. The dark undersuit must connect naturally from waist to hip to knee, with the same clean cel-shaded cloth folds. Do not add limbs, armor, weapons, belts, panels or a rectangular gradient. Strict side view facing right.

source_provenance.mask_source: 04_stages/U_grey.png above knee; reviewed base_rgba.png outline below knee
source_provenance.reason: original single boot outline; consistent pelvis/thigh root overlap; near-side knee plate rather than far-side plate

joint_validation.notes: Original visible pixels retained. U fills occluded undersuit only; lower_outline bounds completed alpha but retains original colors below stage_until. Existing original design/pose history retained.
